provenance.nt_source: Buhmann et al. synapse-type model scores (FlyWire codex exports), aggregated per neuron by classify_neurons.py (threshold 0.50, margin 0.05)
provenance.cell_type_source: NONE PRESENT in workspace; fields reserved for published FlyWire/flyvis cell-type tables via p1_celltypes.import
